faq.q: How do I choose wedding caterers in Gandhidham?
faq.a: List your functions and guest counts first, then shortlist caterers who can handle your menu style and any Jain guests. Ask about their FSSAI licence, service staff, buffet setup and whether a tasting is possible before you book.

faq.q: Can one caterer handle both Jain and regular vegetarian guests?
faq.a: Yes. A pure vegetarian caterer that prepares Jain menus can serve Jain and regular dishes at the same event, with clear labels on the buffet. Olive Catering Company does this for weddings and family functions.

faq.q: When is the peak wedding season in Gujarat?
faq.a: The busiest wedding months in Gujarat usually run from around November to February, along with popular auspicious dates through the year. Contact caterers as soon as your date is fixed.

title: Jain Catering for Weddings and Functions: What to Ask Your Caterer
seo_title: Jain Catering in Gandhidham: What Jain Food Excludes & What to Ask | Olive
description: What Jain catering includes and excludes, Jain-friendly dishes, and the questions to ask your caterer when planning a wedding or function in Gandhidham.
image_alt: Brass thali with dal, kadhi, sabzi, rotli, rice, papad and a sweet

faq.q: What is not allowed in Jain food?
faq.a: Jain food is vegetarian food prepared without onion, garlic, root vegetables such as potato and carrot, and honey. Many Jain guests also prefer to eat before sunset, and some families follow stricter rules on certain days.

faq.q: Does Olive Catering Company provide Jain catering?
faq.a: Yes. Olive Catering Company prepares Jain menus without onion, garlic or root vegetables for weddings, family functions and other events, alongside its regular pure vegetarian menus.

faq.q: Can Jain and non-Jain guests eat from the same buffet?
faq.a: Yes. Jain and regular dishes can share one buffet with clear labels, or Jain dishes can be served at a dedicated counter with separate serving spoons.

faq.q: What should a corporate lunch menu include?
faq.a: A pure vegetarian menu with dal, rice, rotis, one paneer or vegetable curry, a dry sabzi, salad and a light dessert works for most teams. Add clearly labelled Jain dishes if any guests need them.

faq.q: Does Olive provide corporate catering in Gandhidham?
faq.a: Yes. Olive Catering Company caters corporate lunches, meetings, launches and staff events in Gandhidham, with pure vegetarian menus, Jain options and trained service staff.

faq.q: What documents should a corporate caterer provide?
faq.a: Ask for the caterer's FSSAI licence and, if your company needs one, a GST invoice. Confirm site access and setup timings with your facilities team in advance.

faq.q: What is in a typical Gujarati wedding menu?
faq.a: A typical menu has welcome drinks, farsan, dal, kadhi, sabzi, rotli or puri, rice or khichdi, and sweets, often with live counters for variety.

faq.q: How many dishes should a wedding menu have?
faq.a: There is no fixed number. Plan by function and guest count, and balance rich and simple dishes rather than adding more of the same.

faq.q: Can a Gujarati wedding menu be Jain-friendly?
faq.a: Yes. Several dishes can be prepared without onion, garlic or root vegetables and labelled separately on the buffet.

faq.q: Does Olive Catering Company plan Gujarati wedding menus?
faq.a: Yes. Olive plans pure vegetarian and Jain wedding menus in Gandhidham, Kutch and across Gujarat around your functions and guest count.

faq.q: What affects the price of catering?
faq.a: Guest count, menu size, type of dishes, service style, crockery, number of staff, venue distance and the date all affect the quote.

faq.q: Is catering priced per plate or as a package?
faq.a: Both are common. Ask which one the quote uses and exactly what it includes.

faq.q: What should I ask before paying an advance?
faq.a: Ask about the cancellation policy, the date for the final guest count, the FSSAI licence and whether a tasting is possible.

faq.q: How do I get a quote from Olive Catering Company?
faq.a: Send your date, event type, venue and approximate guest count through the enquiry form or on WhatsApp, and Olive will call you back.

faq.q: What should I decide before booking pooja catering?

faq.q: Is pure veg food needed for poojas?

faq.q: Can a caterer handle a small home pooja?
faq.a: Many can. Tell the caterer your guest count and whether you need cooking at the venue or delivered food.

faq.q: When should I book a wedding caterer?
faq.a: As early as your dates and venue are fixed, since good caterers fill up for peak wedding dates.

faq.q: What should I ask a wedding caterer?
faq.a: Ask about the FSSAI licence, menu style, staff, live counters, tasting, quote inclusions and the cancellation policy.

faq.q: Should I taste the food before booking?
faq.a: If possible, yes. Ask for a tasting of the main wedding meal.
